observations: Photo 0 shows a blue-and-black pressure-washer style machine with a handle and a coiled hose/cable on top.
No visible brand/model label, rating plate, or clear control panel details in the photo.
No accessories shown clearly (no spray gun/lance close-up, no hose ends, no power plug close-up).

claims.claim: Our machines are pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance landmarks and they come with...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any certification document, test result, or performance proof; seller text is not verifiable from the image.

risks.risk: Whether it actually works (pump, motor, pressure output) and whether it holds pressure.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running with water connected: start-up, steady pressure, and a trigger spray test (show gauge/pressure if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested until a live run is shown.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (spray gun, lance/nozzle set, hose, fittings) or wrong compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip laying out every included accessory with close-ups of connectors and the spray gun/lance.

risks.risk: Electrical condition and safety (power plug, cable integrity, switch/controls).
risks.proof: Close-up of the power plug and cable condition plus a live power-on test showing the switch/control responding.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one angle (leaks, cracked fittings, worn seals, rust/corrosion).
risks.proof: Video showing water flow and checking for leaks around pump fittings/seals during operation.

proof_requests: Send a video of it running with water connected: start-up + trigger spray for at least 30–60 seconds.
Show a close-up of the rating plate/label (brand, model, voltage, pressure specs).
List and show all included accessories (spray gun, lance/nozzles, hose length, connectors) with clear photos.
Show the power plug/cable close-up and confirm it matches Lagos power requirements.
response.reason: The photo shows a pressure-washer-like machine, but there is no readable brand/model or any proof of working condition or included accessories. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be reliably set.
